cc:Work.dc:title: Observed original/new first100 loss and learning rate
cc:Work.dc:description: Observed prefix only. The scheduler was not rebuilt with max_steps=100: LR remains nonzero at update 100. Warmup has 45 scheduler steps; the update-used LR first reaches its peak at update 46. Pale lines are raw losses; dark lines are trailing means. Matched configuration and aggregate data counts do not prove the original per-ID order or bitwise CUDA replay.
